Field radio

When the network is down, radio still works. A hand-held transceiver needs little power and no infrastructure.

Antenna

Antenna height beats antenna power. A quarter-wave whip raised above obstructions outperforms a fifty-watt signal trapped in a valley.

Power

Radio batteries drain fast. Carry spare cells, or charge from a 12-volt battery with a voltage regulator.

Procedure

Keep transmissions short, state your call sign, and listen before you key. Emergency channels are monitored; do not occupy them for chatter.
